items.title: Three upper bounds for the cohomological dimension of a finitely generated ideal
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects three upper bounds for the cohomological dimension of a finitely generated ideal: by the number of generators, by any family of r elements defining the same closed subset, and by the number of affines needed to cover the complement (author lemma at source lines 690-702, label lemma-bound-cd). The proof (source lines 704-719) reads the first bound off the explicit Cech type description of the derived sections with support, transfers it to any other defining family using the independence of the construction from the chosen ideal, and obtains the third bound from the standard characterisation of cohomological dimension together with the vanishing of the cohomology of quasi-coherent sheaves on a union of c affines. The transfer step (2) is the only part with an argument of its own; parts (1) and (3) are direct from the cited descriptions. H2.
